task: Skip personal/private project creation for users with user_type 'external' or 'service_account' across all creation call sites in the codemie and codemie-enterprise repos.

key_reasoning.reason: 6 call sites across PersonalProjectService, AuthenticationService (x2), RegistrationService (x2), and the enterprise KeycloakMigrationCoordinator, connected only through the duplicated MigrationDeps protocol — a genuine cross-system boundary between two independently-versioned repos, not a single-service change.

The core skip rule is clear, but two decisions are open: whether to extend ensure_personal_project_async's signature or duplicate the user_type check at each call site, and whether already-provisioned personal projects for existing external/service_account users need a cleanup/backfill path — explicitly called out as a spec question, not derivable from code.

No existing gating pattern exists anywhere in the creation path today. The closest analog, is_external_user, deliberately excludes service_account and must not change, leaving the new authz-style check without covering precedent (bump). Acceptance criteria enumerate two specific user_type variants with zero existing test coverage for either in either repo (second, additive bump).

Base repo: personal_project_service.py, authentication_service.py, registration_service.py, the enterprise-adapter coordinator.py, plus 3-4 existing test files needing user_type parametrization. Enterprise repo: migration/coordinator.py and its test file. ~10-11 modified files across 3+ directories in two codebases.

Service layer (PersonalProjectService, AuthenticationService, RegistrationService), the cross-repo integration layer (MigrationDeps protocol / CodemieMigrationDeps / KeycloakMigrationCoordinator), and the security/auth-context layer (user_type on User/UserDB) — spanning two independently-versioned codebases with no shared code, only a duplicated contract.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped: closest existing pattern (User.is_external_user) does not cover the security-sensitive aspect of the new work — it excludes service_account by design and cannot be reused, so the new authz-style check has no covering precedent.
Technical Risk bumped: acceptance criteria enumerate specific user_type variants (external, service_account) and no existing test in either repo parametrizes personal-project creation by user_type.

Component Scope and Affected Layers scored at ceiling (XXL): change spans two independently-versioned repos (codemie, codemie-enterprise) crossing the MigrationDeps protocol boundary — cross-system, not cross-layer.

Component Scope reinforced: change affects multiple workflows (IDP/dev-header login, local login, email-verification registration, instant-login registration, email-change reconciliation, Keycloak bulk migration).
split_recommendation: Split by dependency/phase: (1) Decide and implement the single check point in the base repo — either extend ensure_personal_project_async's signature or introduce one reusable predicate — and land it with tests for the two base-repo call sites in AuthenticationService; (2) apply the same check to the remaining base-repo call sites (RegistrationService x2, PersonalProjectService.reconcile_personal_project_on_email_change) with tests; (3) mirror the check in the enterprise repo's KeycloakMigrationCoordinator._process_batch Phase 3, preserving the existing zero-coupling duplicated-constant convention, with its own tests; (4) resolve as a follow-up/spec item: whether existing external/service_account users' already-provisioned personal projects need cleanup or backfill.
